title: Christmas in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Thursday 24 December: every shop closes at 14:00.** With two public holidays and a Sunday after it, **normal shops stay shut until Monday 28 December**.
**Open on Christmas Eve:** the market on **Gendarmenmarkt** (11:00 to 18:00, 2 euros), the **DDR Museum** (9:00 to 16:00) and **Zoo Berlin** (9:00 to 14:00).

**Closed on Christmas Eve:** every state museum including Museum Island, the Jewish Museum, the **Reichstag dome**, and the markets at the Rotes Rathaus, the Humboldt Forum and Schloss Charlottenburg.
**25 and 26 December:** the state museums open with **Sunday hours** (10:00 to 18:00 on Museum Island), and the four big markets are back. **Charlottenburg closes for the season on 27 December.**
**Food:** the supermarkets in **Hauptbahnhof** and **Ostbahnhof** are the ones that open on the holidays. Book any Christmas dinner now.
**My move:** shop before noon on the 24th, put the museums on the 25th and 26th, and check the one place your day depends on in the hour-by-hour chart in this post.
